Summary: [DS] Historical data backfill — SEC & Alpha Vantage from 2021 to present
Description:
Backfill all historical data from January 2021 to present for all currently supported companies across both SEC and Alpha Vantage data sources. This is a one-time bulk ingestion and processing job, distinct from the daily incremental pipeline. The work covers four sequential phases: (1) SEC historical ingestion — fetch all 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, and DEF 14A filings filed between Jan 2021 and today for all tracked companies, parse and store in sec_filings table with correct filing_type, section, body, and period_date. (2) Alpha Vantage historical ingestion — fetch all available news articles from Jan 2021 to present for all tracked company tickers, store in av_news table with correct published_at and sentiment fields. (3) Metrics calculation — for each company and each historical period (quarterly where applicable), calculate all metrics defined in DS-002 (Metrics Definition Table) and populate company_metrics, company_performance_trends, and company_loan_portfolio tables with the correct period_date and batch_date. (4) AI generation — run the Key Insights, Strategic & Risk Insights, and Follow-Up Questions generation jobs (from the AI generation pipeline requirements) for each company for each historical batch period. Write results to company_insights, company_risk_insights, and company_followup_questions with the corresponding batch_date.

Implementation notes: the backfill job must be idempotent — safe to re-run without creating duplicate rows. Use MERGE or DELETE + INSERT per company per period_date. The job should be runnable in chunks (e.g. one year at a time, or one company at a time) to avoid timeout and rate limit issues. SEC rate limits: max 10 requests/second per EDGAR fair-use policy. Alpha Vantage rate limits: respect tier limits with retry and backoff. AI generation for historical periods should use the same prompt templates and validation logic as the live pipeline, but batch_date should reflect the historical period being processed, not today's date. Log all runs to ai_generation_log with a run_id prefixed 'backfill-' to distinguish from live runs.
Acceptance Criteria: [ ] Phase 1 — SEC ingestion: all 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, DEF 14A filings from Jan 2021 to present fetched and stored in sec_filings for all tracked companies; [ ] Phase 1 — no duplicate rows: idempotent on (company_id, filing_type, period_date, section); [ ] Phase 2 — Alpha Vantage ingestion: all available news articles from Jan 2021 to present stored in av_news for all tracked tickers; [ ] Phase 2 — no duplicate rows: idempotent on (company_id, published_at, headline); [ ] Phase 3 — Metrics: company_metrics, company_performance_trends, and company_loan_portfolio populated for all companies for all historical periods from 2021; [ ] Phase 3 — metric values spot-checked against source SEC filings for at least 3 companies across 3 periods; [ ] Phase 4 — AI generation: company_insights, company_risk_insights, and company_followup_questions populated for all companies for all historical batch periods; [ ] Phase 4 — batch_date correctly reflects historical period, not today; [ ] All backfill runs logged to ai_generation_log with run_id prefixed 'backfill-'; [ ] Job is idempotent — re-running does not create duplicate rows in any output table; [ ] Job can be run in chunks (by year or by company) without breaking correctness; [ ] SEC and Alpha Vantage rate limits respected throughout — no API bans or throttle errors; [ ] Data completeness report produced after backfill: per company, how many periods have SEC data, AV news, metrics, and AI-generated content; gaps documented
